messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Government and Legal Affairs" as it appears in the following examples.
['THIS IS TO OFFICIALLY INFORM YOU THAT WE HAVE VERIFIED YOUR CONTRACT /INHERITANCE FILE AND FOUND OUT THAT WHY YOU HAVE NOT RECEIVED YOUR PAYMENT IS BECAUSE YOU HAVE NOT FULFILLED THE OBLIGATIONS GIVEN TO YOU IN RESPECT OF YOUR CONTRACT/INHERITANCE PAYMENT.', 'I am presently undergoing trial in Abuja though have just been recently granted bail under the condition that my family refunds to the Federal Government some money held in accounts in Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Jersey and in Switzerland.', 'We shall also employ the services of an accredited Attorney for the drafting and notarization of the WILL and to obtain the necessary documents and letters of probate/administration in your favor for the transfer.', 'We the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through our intelligence monitoring network has discovered that the transaction that the bank contacted you previously for was legal.', "Please consult the Litigation Manager and follow the disputes' procedure of removing restrictions.", 'We have received a directive from the Central Bank of Nigeria in your favor.', 'TAX REFUND NOTIFICATION Having carefully access your recent annual calculation of your fiscal activity, our record indicates that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 370.00 GBP.', "Furthermore, my eldest son is in detention by the Nigeria Government for more interrogation about my husband's assets and some vital documents."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
